rationale: Orchestrate 0.7.0 adds an external-authority mode to its execution loop (skill/references/authority.md). Delivery no longer ships its own dispatch and review workflows: it ships skill/workflows/orchestrate-execute.js byte for byte (checked by tests/test_workflows.py against this pin) and implements the authority side in scripts/workflow_steps.py on top of the existing engine commands. The engine stays the only state owner and judge of budgets; tier escalation, tie-breaks and model routing are not used; the Codex runner is not adopted (it refuses authority arguments).
